rebuttals.text: JB Pritzker had the toilets ripped out of his mansion to dodge property taxes.

rebuttals.putForth: JB bought himself a governorship and now he wants to buy the presidency.

rebuttals.text: JB Pritzker is a billionaire heir playing at populism.
Illinois's tax and outmigration record is a general-election anchor.
A Pritzker nomination lets Republicans run against Illinois instead of against a person.
A billionaire nominee forfeits the party's anti-oligarchy argument.
JB Pritzker's wealth insulates him from ever having to build a small-donor movement.
